description: Plan network capacity from utilization analysis through expansion design and cost modeling.

steps.description: Collect current network utilization data across all segments.

inputs.name: network-topology
inputs.desc: Map of network segments, links, and nodes

inputs.name: monitoring-sources
inputs.desc: List of monitoring systems and data feeds

outputs.name: utilization-report
outputs.desc: Current utilization metrics by segment (bandwidth, throughput, latency, packet loss)

outputs.name: peak-usage-patterns
outputs.desc: Peak usage times and volumes by segment

process: Inventory all network segments and their rated capacities.
Pull utilization data from monitoring systems for the reporting period.
Calculate average and peak utilization percentages by segment.
Identify segments approaching threshold (above 70% sustained utilization).

steps.description: Forecast demand growth based on historical trends and business plans.

outputs.name: demand-forecast
outputs.desc: Projected demand by segment for the planning horizon (6, 12, 24 months)

outputs.name: growth-assumptions
outputs.desc: Documented assumptions behind the forecast

process: Analyze historical utilization trends over the past 12 to 24 months.
Factor in planned business changes (new services, customer growth, migrations).
Project demand at 6, 12, and 24 month intervals.
Document assumptions and confidence levels for each projection.

steps.description: Identify current and projected bottlenecks in the network.

outputs.name: bottleneck-list
outputs.desc: List of current and projected bottlenecks ranked by severity

outputs.name: risk-assessment
outputs.desc: Risk of service degradation per segment and timeline

process: Compare projected demand against rated capacity for each segment.
Flag segments that will exceed 80% utilization within the planning horizon.
Rank bottlenecks by severity (time to saturation, number of users affected).
Assess the service impact if each bottleneck is not addressed.

steps.description: Design the capacity expansion plan to address identified bottlenecks.

outputs.name: expansion-plan
outputs.desc: Planned upgrades by segment (hardware, links, peering, CDN)

outputs.name: implementation-timeline
outputs.desc: Phased timeline for each upgrade

process: For each bottleneck, identify the upgrade options (bandwidth increase, hardware upgrade, new links, peering agreements).
Select the option that best balances cost, lead time, and headroom.
Phase the upgrades by priority and dependency.
Document the implementation timeline with milestones.

steps.description: Model the cost of the capacity expansion plan.

outputs.name: cost-model
outputs.desc: Capital and operating cost estimates by phase and segment

outputs.name: capacity-planning-report
outputs.desc: Complete capacity planning report with recommendations

process: Estimate capital costs for each upgrade (equipment, installation, licensing).
Estimate recurring operating costs (power, maintenance, circuit fees).
Calculate the cost per unit of additional capacity.
Compile the full report with utilization data, forecast, bottlenecks, plan, and costs.

description: Provision a telecom service from order receipt through activation and customer handoff.

steps.description: Receive and validate the service order.

inputs.name: service-order
inputs.desc: The customer service order with requested services and specifications

inputs.name: customer-account
inputs.desc: Customer account information and service history

outputs.name: validated-order
outputs.desc: Order validated for completeness and accuracy

outputs.name: order-requirements
outputs.desc: Technical requirements extracted from the order

process: Verify the order contains all required fields (service type, location, bandwidth, SLA tier).
Validate the customer account is in good standing.
Extract the technical requirements from the order.
Flag any missing information and request clarification if needed.

steps.description: Validate that the requested service is technically feasible at the specified location.

outputs.name: feasibility-result
outputs.desc: Feasibility assessment (feasible, feasible with conditions, not feasible)

outputs.name: provisioning-plan
outputs.desc: Technical plan for provisioning the service

process: Check network availability at the service location.
Verify that the requested bandwidth and service type can be delivered.
Identify any infrastructure work required (last mile, equipment installation).
Produce the feasibility result and provisioning plan.

steps.description: Configure the network elements to deliver the service.

outputs.name: configuration-record
outputs.desc: Record of all network element configurations applied

outputs.name: activation-checklist
outputs.desc: Checklist for service activation

process: Configure routers, switches, and access equipment per the provisioning plan.
Set up VLANs, IP addressing, QoS policies, and routing.
Configure monitoring and alerting for the new service.
Document all configurations in the network management system.

steps.description: Activate the service and test end-to-end connectivity.

outputs.name: test-results
outputs.desc: End-to-end test results (connectivity, bandwidth, latency, packet loss)

outputs.name: activation-status
outputs.desc: Service activation status (active, pending remediation)

process: Activate the service on the configured network elements.
Run end-to-end connectivity tests from the customer premises.
Validate bandwidth, latency, and packet loss against the SLA.
Resolve any issues found during testing before handoff.

steps.description: Hand off the activated service to the customer with documentation.

outputs.name: handoff-package
outputs.desc: Customer handoff package with service details, credentials, and support contacts

outputs.name: provisioning-record
outputs.desc: Complete provisioning record for the service

process: Compile the service documentation (circuit ID, IP addresses, credentials, SLA terms).
Deliver the handoff package to the customer.
Confirm the customer can access and use the service.
Close the provisioning order and update the service inventory.

description: Resolve a telecom trouble ticket from report through diagnosis, fix, and verification.

steps.description: Receive and classify the trouble report.

inputs.name: trouble-report
inputs.desc: The reported issue from the customer or monitoring system

inputs.name: service-record
inputs.desc: The affected service record and history

outputs.name: classified-ticket
outputs.desc: Ticket classified by type (voice, data, video, equipment), severity, and priority

outputs.name: initial-diagnosis
outputs.desc: Initial assessment based on symptoms and known issues

process: Log the trouble report with timestamp, reporter, and symptom description.
Classify by service type (voice, data, video) and component (access, transport, core, equipment).
Assign severity based on impact (number of users, service degradation level).
Check for known issues or recent changes that could explain the symptoms.

steps.description: Diagnose the fault through remote testing and analysis.

outputs.name: fault-diagnosis
outputs.desc: Identified fault location and cause

outputs.name: repair-plan
outputs.desc: Plan for fixing the fault (remote fix, dispatch, vendor escalation)

process: Run remote diagnostic tests (ping, traceroute, SNMP polling, loopback tests).
Isolate the fault to a specific network segment or device.
Determine the root cause (hardware failure, configuration error, capacity, external damage).
Decide whether the fix can be applied remotely or requires a field dispatch.

steps.description: Apply the fix to resolve the fault.

outputs.name: repair-result
outputs.desc: Result of the repair action (resolved, partially resolved, escalated)

outputs.name: repair-notes
outputs.desc: Notes on what was done and any remaining issues

process: Execute the repair per the plan (reconfigure, replace hardware, reroute traffic, coordinate with vendor).
If dispatch was required, coordinate the field technician and track the visit.
Verify the fix at the network level (monitoring returns to normal).
Document what was done and any parts or resources consumed.

steps.description: Verify the fix with the customer and close the ticket.

outputs.name: customer-confirmation
outputs.desc: Customer confirmation that the issue is resolved

outputs.name: trouble-resolution-record
outputs.desc: Complete trouble ticket resolution record

process: Contact the customer to confirm the service is restored.
Run a final end-to-end test to verify performance meets the SLA.
Close the ticket with the resolution details and duration.
Update the known issues database if the fault was new.

description: Manage radio spectrum from inventory through utilization monitoring and regulatory compliance.

steps.description: Inventory all current spectrum holdings and licenses.

inputs.name: license-records
inputs.desc: Spectrum license records and regulatory filings

inputs.name: network-deployment
inputs.desc: Current network deployment using the spectrum

outputs.name: spectrum-inventory
outputs.desc: Complete inventory of spectrum holdings by band, geography, and license terms

outputs.name: license-timeline
outputs.desc: License expiration and renewal timeline

process: Catalog all spectrum licenses by frequency band, geographic area, and power limits.
Map each license to the network deployments using that spectrum.
Note license terms, conditions, and expiration dates.
Flag licenses approaching renewal or with buildout requirements.

steps.description: Monitor spectrum utilization and identify underused bands.

outputs.name: utilization-by-band
outputs.desc: Utilization percentage by band and geography

outputs.name: refarming-candidates
outputs.desc: Bands identified as candidates for refarming or sharing

process: Measure traffic and capacity utilization on each band.
Identify bands with sustained low utilization (below 30%).
Assess whether underused bands could serve higher-demand areas through refarming.
Flag bands where spectrum sharing or leasing could generate value.

steps.description: Coordinate interference management across spectrum holdings.

outputs.name: interference-report
outputs.desc: Documented interference issues and resolutions

outputs.name: coordination-agreements
outputs.desc: Coordination agreements with adjacent licensees

process: Monitor for interference complaints and anomalies.
Investigate interference sources (co-channel, adjacent channel, spurious emissions).
Coordinate with adjacent licensees to resolve conflicts.
Document resolutions and update operating parameters.

steps.description: Track and report regulatory compliance for all spectrum holdings.

outputs.name: compliance-status
outputs.desc: Compliance status for each license (compliant, at risk, non-compliant)

outputs.name: spectrum-management-report
outputs.desc: Complete spectrum management report

process: Verify buildout milestones are met for each license.
Confirm emission levels are within authorized limits.
Prepare regulatory filings and renewal applications on schedule.
Compile the spectrum management report with recommendations.

description: Optimize transportation routes from point collection through constraint modeling to driver assignment.

steps.description: Collect and geocode all delivery or service points for the routing period.

inputs.name: delivery-orders
inputs.desc: Orders or service requests to be routed

inputs.name: service-area
inputs.desc: Geographic boundaries of the service area

outputs.name: geocoded-points
outputs.desc: All delivery points with coordinates and service requirements

outputs.name: point-constraints
outputs.desc: Per-point constraints (time windows, access restrictions, special equipment)

process: Extract delivery addresses from the orders.
Geocode each address and validate the coordinates.
Record per-point constraints (time windows, vehicle type requirements, unloading time).
Cluster points by geographic proximity for initial grouping.

steps.description: Model all constraints that affect route feasibility.

outputs.name: constraint-model
outputs.desc: Complete constraint set (vehicle capacity, driver hours, time windows, road restrictions)

outputs.name: vehicle-fleet
outputs.desc: Available vehicles with capacity, type, and home base location

process: Define vehicle constraints (weight capacity, volume, refrigeration, tail lift).
Define driver constraints (hours of service, break requirements, certifications).
Map road restrictions (weight limits, height clearances, time-of-day closures).
Compile the full constraint model for the optimizer.

steps.description: Run the optimization algorithm to generate candidate routes.

outputs.name: candidate-routes
outputs.desc: Set of optimized routes with stop sequences, estimated times, and distances

outputs.name: optimization-metrics
outputs.desc: Total distance, total time, vehicle utilization, constraint violations

process: Select the algorithm based on problem size (nearest neighbor for small, savings algorithm for medium, metaheuristic for large).
Run the optimizer with all constraints.
Generate multiple candidate solutions and select the best by total cost.
Validate that all constraints are satisfied in the selected solution.

steps.description: Validate optimized routes against real-world conditions.

outputs.name: validated-routes
outputs.desc: Routes adjusted for real-world conditions (traffic, construction, weather)

outputs.name: adjustment-notes
outputs.desc: Notes on adjustments made and reasons

process: Check routes against current traffic patterns and known congestion zones.
Incorporate construction closures and detours.
Adjust estimated times for weather conditions if applicable.
Flag any routes that became infeasible after real-world adjustments.

steps.description: Assign validated routes to drivers and produce the route plan.

outputs.name: driver-assignments
outputs.desc: Each route assigned to a specific driver and vehicle

outputs.name: optimized-route-plan
outputs.desc: Complete route plan with manifests, maps, and estimated schedules

process: Match routes to drivers based on location, vehicle type, and certifications.
Balance workload across drivers (hours, stops, distance).
Generate the route manifest for each driver (stop sequence, addresses, time windows, special instructions).
Distribute the route plan and confirm driver acknowledgment.

description: Set up dispatch operations from territory definition through rules, communication, and monitoring.

steps.description: Define the service territory and zones for dispatch.

inputs.name: demand-data
inputs.desc: Historical and projected service demand by area

outputs.name: zone-map
outputs.desc: Service territory divided into dispatch zones with boundaries

outputs.name: zone-profiles
outputs.desc: Profile for each zone (demand volume, travel times, crew requirements)

process: Divide the service area into zones based on geographic boundaries and demand density.
Estimate travel times between zones and within each zone.
Determine the crew count and skill mix needed per zone.
Document the zone map with boundaries and profiles.

steps.description: Configure the dispatch rules for job assignment.

outputs.name: dispatch-rules
outputs.desc: Rules for assigning jobs (priority, proximity, skill match, load balancing)

outputs.name: escalation-rules
outputs.desc: Rules for escalating unassigned or overdue jobs

process: Define priority levels for job types (emergency, urgent, scheduled, routine).
Set assignment rules: assign to the nearest available crew with the required skill.
Configure load balancing to prevent overloading any single crew.
Set escalation triggers for jobs not assigned within the target time.

steps.description: Design the communication protocol between dispatch and field crews.

outputs.name: communication-protocol
outputs.desc: How dispatch communicates with field crews (channels, formats, frequency)

outputs.name: status-update-rules
outputs.desc: Required status updates from field crews (en route, on site, completed)

process: Select the communication channels (mobile app, radio, SMS, phone).
Define the job dispatch message format (job ID, address, description, priority, customer contact).
Set the required status updates (acknowledged, en route, on site, work started, completed).
Design the feedback loop for crews to report issues or request support.

steps.description: Set up real-time monitoring of dispatch operations.

outputs.name: monitoring-dashboard
outputs.desc: Dashboard design for tracking job status, crew locations, and KPIs

outputs.name: dispatch-operations-plan
outputs.desc: Complete dispatch operations plan

process: Design the dispatch board showing open jobs, assigned jobs, and crew locations.
Configure KPI tracking (response time, completion rate, jobs per crew per day).
Set up alerts for SLA breaches, crew idle time, and unacknowledged jobs.
Compile the full dispatch operations plan document.

description: Manage commercial drivers from recruitment through compliance, training, and performance monitoring.

steps.description: Recruit and screen commercial driver candidates.

inputs.name: driver-requirements
inputs.desc: Required qualifications (CDL class, endorsements, experience, clean record)

inputs.name: open-positions
inputs.desc: Number and type of driver positions to fill

outputs.name: screened-candidates
outputs.desc: Candidates who passed screening (MVR, background, drug test, road test)

outputs.name: screening-records
outputs.desc: Screening results and documentation for each candidate

process: Post the driver positions and source candidates.
Verify CDL validity and endorsements.
Run motor vehicle record (MVR) check, background check, and pre-employment drug screen.
Conduct a road test and evaluate driving skills.

steps.description: Manage ongoing CDL compliance and medical certificates.

outputs.name: compliance-tracker
outputs.desc: Status of each driver's compliance items (CDL renewal, medical card, endorsements)

outputs.name: expiration-alerts
outputs.desc: Alerts for upcoming expirations

process: Build the driver qualification file for each driver per FMCSA requirements.
Track CDL expiration dates, medical certificate renewals, and endorsement statuses.
Set automated alerts for items expiring within 60 days.
Conduct annual MVR reviews and document the results.

steps.description: Schedule training and safety courses for drivers.

outputs.name: training-schedule
outputs.desc: Training calendar with required and elective courses

outputs.name: training-records
outputs.desc: Completed training records by driver

process: Identify required training (hazmat, defensive driving, hours of service, cargo securement).
Schedule refresher courses before certifications expire.
Track completion and record training hours.
Identify additional training needs based on incident trends.

steps.description: Monitor driver performance using telematics and incident data.

outputs.name: performance-scorecards
outputs.desc: Performance scorecard per driver (safety score, fuel efficiency, on-time delivery)

outputs.name: driver-management-report
outputs.desc: Complete driver management program report

process: Collect telematics data (hard braking, speeding, idle time, hours of service compliance).
Calculate a safety score for each driver.
Review incidents and near-misses, assign corrective actions.
Produce the driver management report with trends and recommendations.

description: Maintain DOT compliance from regulation identification through process implementation and audit preparation.

steps.description: Identify the applicable DOT and FMCSA regulations for the operation.

inputs.name: operation-profile
inputs.desc: Description of the fleet operation (vehicle types, cargo, routes, interstate vs intrastate)

inputs.name: current-compliance-status
inputs.desc: Current state of compliance documentation and processes

outputs.name: applicable-regulations
outputs.desc: List of regulations that apply, organized by topic (hours of service, vehicle inspection, driver qualification, hazmat)

outputs.name: gap-assessment
outputs.desc: Gaps between current compliance and requirements

process: Determine the operating authority type and registration requirements.
Identify applicable FMCSA regulations based on vehicle class, cargo type, and operating radius.
Compare current practices against each regulation to identify gaps.
Prioritize gaps by regulatory risk and penalty exposure.

steps.description: Implement the compliance processes to close identified gaps.

outputs.name: compliance-procedures
outputs.desc: Written procedures for each compliance area

outputs.name: documentation-templates
outputs.desc: Templates for required forms and records

process: Write the procedures for each compliance area (daily vehicle inspections, hours of service logging, drug and alcohol testing).
Create the required documentation templates (DVIR, driver logs, inspection reports).
Assign responsibility for each compliance task.
Set up the record retention system per FMCSA requirements.

steps.description: Manage driver qualification files per FMCSA requirements.

outputs.name: dq-file-status
outputs.desc: Status of each driver's qualification file (complete, missing items, expired items)

outputs.name: dq-action-items
outputs.desc: Action items to bring all files into compliance

process: Verify each driver file contains all required documents (application, MVR, medical certificate, road test, annual review).
Flag missing or expired documents.
Generate action items with deadlines for each missing item.
Track completion of action items.

steps.description: Conduct self-audits and prepare for DOT compliance reviews.

outputs.name: self-audit-results
outputs.desc: Results of the self-audit by compliance area

outputs.name: dot-compliance-report
outputs.desc: Complete DOT compliance program report with readiness assessment

process: Conduct the self-audit using the FMCSA compliance review checklist.
Score each area (satisfactory, conditional, unsatisfactory).
Develop corrective action plans for any deficiencies.
Compile the compliance program report with current status and audit readiness.

description: Schedule public transit services from ridership analysis through route design and operator assignment.

steps.description: Analyze ridership data and demand patterns.

inputs.name: ridership-data
inputs.desc: Historical ridership counts by route, stop, and time period

inputs.name: service-area-demographics
inputs.desc: Population density, employment centers, and transit-dependent populations

outputs.name: demand-patterns
outputs.desc: Ridership demand by time of day, day of week, and geography

outputs.name: underserved-areas
outputs.desc: Areas with unmet demand or poor service coverage

process: Analyze ridership by route and time period to identify peak and off-peak patterns.
Map demand hotspots and corridors with the highest passenger volumes.
Identify areas where demand exceeds capacity or service is sparse.
Compare demand against current service levels to find gaps.

steps.description: Design or adjust routes and stops based on demand analysis.

outputs.name: route-network
outputs.desc: Route map with stop locations and connections

outputs.name: service-standards
outputs.desc: Service frequency, span, and capacity targets per route

process: Design routes to connect high-demand origins and destinations.
Place stops at locations with the best balance of coverage and travel speed.
Set service frequency targets by time period (peak: 10-15 min, midday: 20-30 min, evening: 30-60 min).
Ensure connections between routes at transfer points.

steps.description: Assign vehicles to runs based on the service plan.

outputs.name: vehicle-blocks
outputs.desc: Vehicle assignments (which bus covers which runs throughout the day)

outputs.name: fleet-requirement
outputs.desc: Total vehicles needed (peak, spare ratio)

process: Build the timetable with departure times for each route and direction.
Chain trips into vehicle blocks that minimize deadhead (non-revenue) time.
Calculate the peak vehicle requirement and add the spare ratio.
Assign vehicle types based on route demand and road constraints.

steps.description: Assign operators to runs and publish the schedule.

outputs.name: operator-roster
outputs.desc: Operator assignments with work rules compliance (spread time, break requirements)

outputs.name: published-schedule
outputs.desc: Published transit schedule for riders and operations

process: Build operator runs from vehicle blocks, respecting labor agreement rules (max spread, minimum break, overtime limits).
Assign operators to runs based on seniority, qualifications, and availability.
Publish the internal operations schedule and the public rider schedule.
Compile the complete transit scheduling document.

description: Broker a freight shipment from load receipt through carrier matching, booking, and paperwork management.

steps.description: Receive and validate the shipper's load details.

inputs.name: load-request
inputs.desc: Shipper's load details (origin, destination, commodity, weight, dimensions, pickup/delivery dates)

outputs.name: validated-load
outputs.desc: Load details validated for completeness and feasibility

outputs.name: rate-estimate
outputs.desc: Estimated market rate for the lane based on current conditions

process: Verify load details are complete (commodity, weight, dimensions, hazmat status, temperature requirements).
Confirm pickup and delivery dates and windows.
Estimate the market rate for the lane using historical data and current spot market.
Check the shipper's credit and payment terms.

steps.description: Search the carrier network for available capacity.

outputs.name: carrier-options
outputs.desc: List of available carriers with rates, equipment, and service history

outputs.name: carrier-scores
outputs.desc: Carrier scores based on reliability, price, and compliance

process: Search the carrier database for available trucks in the origin area matching the equipment requirements.
Check load boards for additional carrier options.
Score each carrier on reliability (on-time percentage), price, insurance, and safety rating.
Shortlist the top candidates for negotiation.

steps.description: Negotiate the rate and book the carrier.

outputs.name: booking-confirmation
outputs.desc: Confirmed booking with carrier, rate, and terms

outputs.name: rate-confirmation-doc
outputs.desc: Rate confirmation document signed by both parties

process: Contact the top-ranked carrier and negotiate the rate.
Confirm equipment type, pickup time, and delivery expectations.
Issue the rate confirmation with all terms (accessorial charges, detention, layover).
Get the carrier's signed acceptance.

steps.description: Track the shipment from pickup to delivery.

outputs.name: tracking-updates
outputs.desc: Location and status updates throughout transit

outputs.name: exception-log
outputs.desc: Any exceptions (delays, damage, reroutes) logged during transit

process: Confirm pickup with the carrier (driver name, truck number, pickup time).
Set check-call schedule for in-transit updates.
Relay status updates to the shipper.
Log and manage any exceptions (delays, breakdowns, weather).

steps.description: Manage the paperwork and close the load.

outputs.name: completed-documents
outputs.desc: Bill of lading, proof of delivery, and invoice package

outputs.name: brokerage-record
outputs.desc: Complete brokerage record for the shipment

process: Collect the signed bill of lading (BOL) and proof of delivery (POD).
Verify delivery against the original load details (on time, no damage, correct count).
Process the carrier invoice and issue payment per terms.
Invoice the shipper and compile the complete brokerage record.
